name: Bluffton University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2025-26 full-time undergraduate tuition ($37,660, 12-17 hrs/semester) from bluffton.edu/admissions/financialaid/tuition.aspx; room shown separately from board (room only). Housing_cost is standard Bren-Dell/Ropp/Hirschy annual room rate ($6,196); other options: Ramseyer/Neufeld A/C $6,300, Riley Court Apartments $8,916. Board (meals) is separate: $6,136-$6,656/yr depending on plan.
